findings.location: Definition, opening paragraph, sentence 2 (line 41): the sentence naming orientation and unspecified spin or related lifting data as the model's tangential structure.
findings.evidence: The sentence does not specify the type of the additional structure or any structure map/lift of TM, and none of the six declared suppliers defines it. Schommer-Pries, Geometry & Topology 22 (2018), §1, PDF pp. 2714–2715, defines an (X, ξ)-structure by a lift of the tangent-bundle classifying map τ_M: M → BO(d) through ξ: X → BO(d), with spin structures as the BSpin(d) case: [Schommer-Pries source](https://msp.org/gt/2018/22-5/gt-v22-n5-p05-s.pdf). The Definition needs the exact chosen tangential-structure input.
